dialog.loginApproval.title: macOS needs your permission
dialog.loginApproval.detail: Open System Settings → General → Login Items and turn on Lyric Wall.
ui.queueLater: The queue will appear in a later step.
lyrics.offline: No connection to LRCLIB. I will try again in a minute
lyrics.busy: LRCLIB is busy. I will try again in a minute
lyrics.error: Could not load the lyrics. Details are in the log
state.starting.title: Looking for Spotify…
state.not-running.title: Spotify is not running
state.not-running.detail: Open Spotify and the current track will appear here
state.stopped.title: Nothing is playing
state.not-installed.title: Spotify not found
state.no-permission.title: No access to Spotify
state.no-permission.detail: System Settings → Privacy & Security → Automation → Lyric Wall → turn on Spotify
state.error.title: Can't read Spotify
state.error.detail: Details are in the log (tray icon → Open log)
control.hint.mac: You can close this window: the wallpaper keeps running. The icon is in the menu bar.
control.hint.win: You can close this window: the wallpaper keeps running. The icon is in the tray next to the clock.
look.title: Settings
look.subtitle: Changes appear on the wallpaper right away and are saved.
look.badImage: Could not open this picture. Try a JPG or PNG.
look.pauseHint: Fewer frames use less power. The wallpaper always pauses when the screen is locked, the computer sleeps or (on Windows) a game or another app is full screen.
ui.likeLater: Likes will work after signing in to Spotify (step 9)
look.audioHint.mac: The bars always show the Spotify volume. To make them move with the music, macOS asks for the "Screen & System Audio Recording" permission (System Settings → Privacy & Security). Only the sound is used, nothing is recorded or saved.
look.audioHint.win: The bars always show the system volume and, with this on, move with the music. Only the sound is used, nothing is recorded or saved.
welcome.title: Lyric Wall is running
welcome.body.mac: The wallpaper is on. Settings and controls are in the menu bar icon.
welcome.body.win: The wallpaper is on. Settings and controls are in the tray icon next to the clock.
